method: Actual GuardRuntime with repeated identical goals across bounded tenants; unique idempotency keys; cache-enabled and cache-disabled arms. Record-call count is a proxy for plan-record/preparation-path work, not a monetary cost measurement.
limitation: This is an in-process micro-experiment, not a production cost benchmark. GuardRuntime's current plan preparation is deliberately tiny (one metadata step), so the measured latency difference must not be presented as a general cost-saving percentage.
